data.description: Elevation allows elements to be lifted from the background. It can be defined by applying drop shadows or other visual cues, such as color and borders

shadows.description: Elevation using shadows reflects a spatial relationship by indicating separation from the background or allowing content to be scrolled under another element.

levels.name: Floating Element
levels.description: Multi-layer shadow with subtle opacity (3%, 5%, 10%) providing floating elevation for cards, dropdowns, and modals. Blur values: 2px, 4px, 24px.

levels.name: Raised Element
levels.description: Heavier multi-layer shadow with 6 levels of increasing blur (3px to 120px) and opacity (5% to ~7%) for highly elevated elements like terminal windows. Creates deep depth.

levels.name: Model Family Card
levels.description: Simple soft shadow for model family cards with 10% black opacity and 6px blur.

levels.name: Button Primary
levels.description: Multi-layer button shadow with outer shadows and inset highlights for 3D button effect. Includes inset white highlights at 12% and 20% opacity.

levels.name: Button Hover
levels.description: Reduced outer shadow on hover with retained inset highlights for pressed button appearance.

levels.name: Webflow Badge
levels.description: Subtle badge shadow with 10% black opacity border simulation and soft drop shadow.
